| File | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `manners-prompt.png` | Somebody buffed you. One press. | Somebody buffed you in passing, and Manners puts them on the prompt. Click it or press your key: they get your buff back, your own target comes straight back, and the game confirms it. |
| `manners-actionbar.png` | On a key, a bar or a controller | Bind Buff the prompted player to a key, or drop the Manners macro on any action bar slot: the slot shows the spell a press would cast, with its cooldown. A controller button bound the same way works too, and the prompt shows the button's picture. |
| `manners-reasons.png` | Why somebody is on the prompt | Your target, somebody who buffed you, somebody who asked in chat, your group, and passers-by missing your buff -- each in its own colour, offered in that order. |
| `manners-more.png` | More than buffs | A resurrection for a dead member of your group, a cure for a poison, disease, curse or harmful spell, water, food or a portal for whoever asks a mage or a warlock in chat, and one polite whisper asking for a buff you are missing. Each has its own switch. |
| `manners-yourself.png` | Your own buffs too | When your own armor, poison or buff is missing, you come up on the prompt as "You": a mage's armor, a rogue's poison for the main hand, your own Arcane Intellect. |
| `manners-list.png` | Click any name | Switch on List the next few below (Look) and every name under the prompt is a button, with the icon of the buff they would get. Left-click buffs that person, right-click skips them for now, shift-right-click never offers them again. |
| `manners-tooltip.png` | A tooltip that stays out of the way | Hover the prompt for the Short tooltip: the name, the spell and why they are offered. Hold Shift for the Full one, which says what the press and each click do. Short, Full, Shift only or Off, and where it shows, under Look. |
| `manners-looks.png` | Thirty looks to choose from | Glass, the default, then every other look on its shelf, Classic, Minimal, Themed and Class, the same favour drawn in each; click a card under Look to switch. |
| `manners-look-stormcaller.gif` | The Shaman look, as a buff lands | Animated: somebody buffed you, you press, and chain lightning arcs from the totem to the standing stone. |
| `manners-look-lightbringer.gif` | The Paladin look, as a buff lands | Animated: somebody buffed you, you press, and the sun of the Light flares round your spell. |
| `manners-moment.png` | Three moments | Film strips of one favour, four frames each: somebody buffs you, your buff lands, the game refuses it. Frames at 0.05, 0.15, 0.30 and 0.60 seconds. |
| `manners-ledger.png` | The favour ledger | Who buffed you, whether you returned it, and who you buffed without being asked. Open it with /manners ledger. |
| `manners-options.png` | Set it up in one window | Open it with /manners or the minimap button. Shown on Start here in the Simple view, just the essentials: two questions and one key. Untick Simple view for everything; Move the prompt is one click away in the header. |
| `manners-options-wide.png` | Drag it wide | Drag the corner and a page flows into two columns, three on an ultrawide screen. Shown on Who to buff for a paladin: who is offered, what to cast, the group, Resurrection and cures on one screen. |
| `manners-languages.png` | In your language | English and eight translations, chosen by your game client. Shown here in German, French and Simplified Chinese. |
| `manners-palette.png` | A palette for colour blindness | The five reason colours redrawn for red-green colour blindness, one setting away under Look > Style. |
